comment: Currently-known unwired subsystems tolerated by tools/wiring_connectivity_audit.py. Every entry is a real 'implemented but never wired into live runtime' gap found at baseline; the audit FAILS on any NEW unwired tick/bridge/channel/save-tag/entrypoint. A landing wire makes its entry stale (warn by default, hard-fail under --fail-on-stale) — prune, never add silently. fn/bridge entries match on check+symbol+file; channel entries match on check+symbol (sites are documentation).

Orbital dimension registration staged for the aeronautics space lane; the live path registers descriptors straight into the offload router from `dimension_mod_ensure_orbital_dimension`, so this wrapper is a caller-less duplicate.

Client decodes the Create kinetic update channel; neither the server bridge nor create-adapter ever emits it (kinetic_sync_v1 is symmetric, update_v1 is client-only).
Router-classified accessory sync channel; exists only in the shared channel table — no server emitter, no client handler.
Client-side skeletal-animation channel decoder exists; the server emitter lives only in live_mod_bridge test code — the channel is never sent.
Alpha6 CKH1 codec and sans-IO planner only; no live server sender or client receiver. Remove this waiver when both endpoints are wired.
Claims sync is router-classified and claims_wire frames exist in server tooling, but neither the live server nor the client handles the channel.
Server LOD opt-in channel is live; client-app has the LOD codec (encode_lod_v1/decode_lod_v1) but never binds it to the channel name — the client can never opt in.
Router-classified media transfer channel; shared-table entry only, no producer or consumer.

MSY1 manifest decode staged for the mod-sync download path; only fuzz/test callers exist.
